name: nonApi_findRunForTrack
description: Internal, no auth. The matching rule behind a track import (E5.F5.S6/S7), split out of hcapp_findRunForTrack on 2026-09-11 so the app (HC6.hcapp_findRunForTrack, which authenticates and then calls this) and the server-side import processor (api/Endpoints/TrackImportProcessor.cs) match identically. Given a track's first/last point times (UTC) and first position, returns up to 10 visible, non-deleted, non-removed runs whose EventStartDateTimeGmt lies in [firstPointUtc − 3 h, lastPointUtc], nearest start time to the first point first, with the distance from each run's recorded start, the caller's existing trail points and attendance state. Callers apply the rest: a recorded start must be within a mile; no recorded start ⇒ needs a human; several ⇒ needs a choice. Instant ⇒ EventStartDateTimeGmt (hc-event-datetimes).

rowsets.name: CandidateRuns
rowsets.description: Up to 10 candidate runs, ORDER BY ABS(seconds between EventStartDateTimeGmt and @firstPointUtc). Empty when nothing started in the window.

columns.name: eventName
columns.description: HC.Event.EventName (the run's own name; the Fb* import mirror is not consulted).

columns.name: eventStartLocal
columns.description: CAST(EventStartDatetime AS DATETIME2(0)) — the wall-clock start with the offset dropped (same value as EventStartLocal, to the second).

columns.name: hasLocation
columns.description: 1 when a non-zero start location is recorded.

columns.name: existingTrackPoints
columns.description: The caller's HC.HasherEventMap.TrackPointCount (INT NULL) on this run; 0 when no live row or no trail.

columns.name: attendenceState
columns.description: The caller's HC.HasherEventMap.AttendenceState on this run (live row with the most track points); 0 when none. >= 20 = attended.

sideEffects: None (read only). On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('<unknown>', userId) then THROW.

codeSmells.detail: All five parameters (lines 2-6) have no SQL default. Both callers (hcapp_findRunForTrack, TrackImportProcessor) always pass them; a NULL @latitude/@longitude reaching geography::Point (line 31) errors inside the TRY and is logged.
Line 23 sets NOCOUNT only. Read-only SP, so no practical effect.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
